title: Trigonometric Equations and General Values
notes: **General solution:** because trigonometric functions are periodic, equations have infinitely many solutions. The general solution gives all possible solutions using an integer parameter $n$.
**Why squared forms differ for cos:** cosine is even, so both $\theta$ and $-\theta$ give the same cosine value. This halves the period in the general solution.
**Solving strategy:** isolate the trig function, find the reference angle $\alpha$, then apply the appropriate general solution form. Always verify with the original equation.
